import os
import re
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv()
from relocation_jobs.core.outbound_mail import brevo_configured, send_transactional_email

to = os.environ.get("PANEL_ADMIN_EMAILS", "").split(",")[0].strip()
print("configured", brevo_configured())
print("to", to)
print("from", os.environ.get("BREVO_FROM_EMAIL"))
try:
    send_transactional_email(
        to=to,
        subject="Kuchup localhost Brevo test",
        text="This is a localhost test of transactional email via Brevo. If you received it, the API key and sender are working.",
    )
    print("result ok")
except Exception as exc:
    import requests
    api_key = os.environ.get("BREVO_API_KEY", "").strip()
    from_email = os.environ.get("BREVO_FROM_EMAIL", "").strip()
    from_name = os.environ.get("BREVO_FROM_NAME", "").strip() or "Kuchup"
    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email",
        headers={"accept": "application/json", "content-type": "application/json", "api-key": api_key},
        json={
            "sender": {"name": from_name, "email": from_email},
            "to": [{"email": to}],
            "subject": "Kuchup localhost Brevo test",
            "textContent": "This is a localhost test of transactional email via Brevo.",
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    body = response.text
    if api_key:
        body = body.replace(api_key, "[redacted]")
    body = re.sub(r"xkeysib-[A-Za-z0-9\-]+", "[redacted]", body)
    print("result fail", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
    print("status", response.status_code)
    print("body", body[:800])
PY

def dotenv(path):

    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        s = line.strip()

            continue
        k, v = s.split("=", 1)
        out[k.strip()] = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
    return out

env = dotenv(root / ".env")

key = env.get("BREVO_API_KEY", "")
from_email = env.get("BREVO_FROM_EMAIL", "")
from_name = env.get("BREVO_FROM_NAME", "") or "Kuchup"
